newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DHL, UPS not introducing surcharges. [CORRECTED 02:35 GMT 27/11]
newsitem.headline: DHL, UPS not introducing surcharges. [CORRECTED 02:35 GMT 27/11]

text.p: DHL Worldwide Express will not be introducing a fuel surcharge, a Netherlands-based spokesman said.
"We do not have any intention of implementing a fuel surcharge this year," he added.
He said that the express operator will not be reviewing its rates until July 1997.
United Parcel Service is another integrator that is not introducing a fuel surcharge, a UPS spokesman said.
UPS had just launched its new rates and these were not expected to change in the near future, he added.

Last week Federal Express said it was introducing a 10 U.S. cent a kilo surcharge on non-express (Corrects from "all traffic") originating in Europe effective December 1. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
